## Useful qualities to study

The README documents transactions, budgets, reports, imports/exports, multi-currency balances, and self-hosted finance workflows. Its emphasis on a ledger, exact financial records, and explicit import paths is relevant as product-domain context.

## Relevance to ChargesTBA

Potential reference for transaction-history terminology, financial-data states, and user-controlled imports. ChargesTBA currently focuses on condominium charges, schedules, payment allocations, and a local account; do not import broader budgeting, banking, or account-sharing features without a product decision.
